list.name: serial
list.label: Device
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT serial_number FROM devices ORDER BY serial_number

list.name: circuit
list.label: Circuit
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT concat(group_idx, '_', circuit_idx) AS __value, concat('Group ', group_idx, ' Circuit ', circuit_idx) AS __text FROM circuit_samples WHERE serial_number = '$serial' ORDER BY 1

list.name: price_per_1000kwh
list.label: Price per 1000 kWh ($)
list.description: Substituted directly into SQL as a number -- enter a plain numeric value (e.g. 150), not currency-formatted text.

targets.rawSql: SELECT serial_number AS "Serial", hub_id AS "Hub ID", last_seen_at AS "Last Seen", first_seen_at AS "First Seen" FROM devices ORDER BY last_seen_at DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT time AS "time", watts AS "value", concat('G', group_idx, ' C', circuit_idx) AS metric FROM circuit_samples WHERE serial_number = '$serial' AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time
SELECT time AS "time", true_power_kw AS "value", concat('Group ', group_idx) AS metric FROM group_samples WHERE serial_number = '$serial' AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time
SELECT time AS "time", voltage AS "value", concat('Group ', group_idx) AS metric FROM group_samples WHERE serial_number = '$serial' AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time
SELECT time AS "time", frequency AS "value", concat('Group ', group_idx) AS metric FROM group_samples WHERE serial_number = '$serial' AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time
SELECT time AS "time", power_factor AS "value", concat('G', group_idx, ' C', circuit_idx) AS metric FROM circuit_samples WHERE serial_number = '$serial' AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

SELECT time AS "time", watts AS "value", concat('G', group_idx, ' C', circuit_idx) AS metric FROM circuit_samples WHERE serial_number = '$serial' AND concat(group_idx, '_', circuit_idx) = '$circuit' AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Circuit Usage & Cost (set price in the "Price per 1000 kWh" box above)

targets.rawSql: WITH deltas AS (SELECT group_idx, circuit_idx, watts, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (time - LAG(time) OVER (PARTITION BY group_idx, circuit_idx ORDER BY time))) AS dt_seconds FROM circuit_samples WHERE serial_number = '$serial' AND time >= date_trunc('day', now())) SELECT concat('G', group_idx, ' C', circuit_idx) AS "Circuit", ROUND((SUM(watts * LEAST(COALESCE(dt_seconds, 0), 300)) / 3600.0 / 1000.0)::numeric, 3) AS "kWh", ROUND((SUM(watts * LEAST(COALESCE(dt_seconds, 0), 300)) / 3600.0 / 1000.0 * (${price_per_1000kwh} / 1000.0))::numeric, 2) AS "Cost ($)" FROM deltas GROUP BY group_idx, circuit_idx ORDER BY group_idx, circuit_idx

WITH deltas AS (SELECT group_idx, circuit_idx, watts, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (time - LAG(time) OVER (PARTITION BY group_idx, circuit_idx ORDER BY time))) AS dt_seconds FROM circuit_samples WHERE serial_number = '$serial' AND time >= date_trunc('week', now())) SELECT concat('G', group_idx, ' C', circuit_idx) AS "Circuit", ROUND((SUM(watts * LEAST(COALESCE(dt_seconds, 0), 300)) / 3600.0 / 1000.0)::numeric, 3) AS "kWh", ROUND((SUM(watts * LEAST(COALESCE(dt_seconds, 0), 300)) / 3600.0 / 1000.0 * (${price_per_1000kwh} / 1000.0))::numeric, 2) AS "Cost ($)" FROM deltas GROUP BY group_idx, circuit_idx ORDER BY group_idx, circuit_idx

WITH deltas AS (SELECT group_idx, circuit_idx, watts, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (time - LAG(time) OVER (PARTITION BY group_idx, circuit_idx ORDER BY time))) AS dt_seconds FROM circuit_samples WHERE serial_number = '$serial' AND time >= date_trunc('month', now())) SELECT concat('G', group_idx, ' C', circuit_idx) AS "Circuit", ROUND((SUM(watts * LEAST(COALESCE(dt_seconds, 0), 300)) / 3600.0 / 1000.0)::numeric, 3) AS "kWh", ROUND((SUM(watts * LEAST(COALESCE(dt_seconds, 0), 300)) / 3600.0 / 1000.0 * (${price_per_1000kwh} / 1000.0))::numeric, 2) AS "Cost ($)" FROM deltas GROUP BY group_idx, circuit_idx ORDER BY group_idx, circuit_idx
